s.g: A native or inhabitant of Uzbekistan.

A member of a Central Asian Turkic ethnic group native to Uzbekistan and neighboring countries, with significant, centuries-old indigenous populations across northern Afghanistan, Tajikistan, and Kyrgyzstan.
Of, from, or pertaining to Uzbekistan, the Uzbek people or the Uzbek language.
A citizen or national of Uzbekistan.
Of or pertaining to Uzbekistan, its people and culture.

uzhe.f: (slang, chiefly in the singular) Clipping of usual.

s.g: A type of compact submachine gun, having a caliber of 9 millimeters with ammunition housed in the grip of the weapon.
